title: VR战士2
creator: Sega AM2
note: SEGA Model 2 基板上的 3D 格斗教科书，没有飞行道具，纯靠走位与帧数判定立身，是写实格斗流派的原点。
noteEn: The Sega Model 2 textbook of 3D fighting — no fireballs, just footwork and frame data that founded the realistic branch.

title: 真人快打2
creator: Midway
note: 终结技升级为血池与断头等名场面，藏了 Jade、Smoke、Noob Saibot 三个秘密角色，把话题性炼成了真格斗游戏。
noteEn: Fatalities escalated to pit and spine-rip classics, with hidden fighters Jade, Smoke and Noob Saibot turning notoriety into craft.

title: 街头霸王3三度冲击
creator: Capcom
note: 「格挡」让攻守逆转只在一帧之间，Evo 2004 梅原大吾的背水逆转至今仍是格斗电竞赛事的传说。
noteEn: The parry flips offense and defense in a single frame; Daigo's Evo Moment 37 remains fighting-game esports folklore.

title: 魂之利刃
creator: Namco
note: 刀剑格斗引入八方向移动，武器相克与判定精密，Dreamcast 首发护航之作，Metacritic 98 至今是格斗游戏之最。
noteEn: Weapon-based combat with eight-way-run movement and razor hitboxes; a Dreamcast launch title that still tops Metacritic at 98.

title: 漫画英雄VS卡普空2
en: Marvel vs. Capcom 2: New Age of Heroes
creator: Capcom
note: 3v3 换人加空中连段的高速大乱斗，56 名角色的狂野阵容把「助阵格斗」推到极致。
noteEn: Chaotic 3v3 tags and air combos; a 56-character roster that pushed assist fighters to their peak.

title: 拳皇'98
creator: SNK
note: 3v3 组队制与「梦想对决」全明星阵容，SNK 把前两代系统打磨到极致，成为拳皇系列的竞技天花板。
noteEn: Three-on-three teams and a dream-match all-star roster; SNK's polished peak, still the series' competitive gold standard.

title: 龙珠斗士Z
creator: Arc System Works
note: 2.5D 手绘质感的 3v3 组队战，把龙珠的瞬移与对波做成行云流水的格斗，拿下 2018 TGA 最佳格斗游戏。
noteEn: Hand-drawn 2.5D 3v3 battles translate Dragon Ball's teleports and ki blasts into fluid fighting — TGA 2018 Best Fighting Game.

title: NHL冰球94
creator: EA Canada
note: 一键传球与行云流水的滑行手感，被一代玩家与媒体奉为「史上最好的冰球游戏」。
noteEn: One-button passing and effortless skating flow — widely hailed as the greatest hockey game ever made.

title: 托尼·霍克滑板3
creator: Neversoft
note: 新增的「回板」让连招在地面与空中彻底打通，Metacritic 97 至今是滑板游戏不可逾越的高峰。
noteEn: The revert bridged manual and air combos into one endless line; at 97 it remains the skate-game benchmark.

title: NBA 2K11
creator: Visual Concepts
note: 「乔丹挑战模式」重现飞人的十场传奇比赛，把怀旧与拟真手感缝合，是 2K 系列的封神一作。
noteEn: The Jordan Challenge replays ten MJ legends, fusing nostalgia with sim polish — the 2K series' masterpiece.

title: 马力欧高尔夫：蘑菇杯巡回赛
creator: Camelot Software Planning
note: Camelot 把挥杆计量做得既严谨又任天堂式亲切，力度与风向的博弈让人一杆接一杆停不下来。
noteEn: Camelot's swing meter is demanding yet approachable — wind and power gambling that hooks for hours.

title: 马力欧网球
creator: Camelot Software Planning
note: N64 四人对战神器，强力扣杀与刁钻角度让菜鸟和高手在同一张网上找到乐趣，Metacritic 91 的合家欢巅峰。
noteEn: The N64's four-player killer app; power shots and sharp angles keep rookies and pros on the same court.

title: NBA街头篮球
creator: EA Canada
note: 3v3 街头斗牛把 NBA 球星放进铁笼球场，花式运球与「灌篮火拼」比正代更自由奔放。
noteEn: 3-on-3 streetball drops NBA stars into cage courts; tricks and dunk battles feel freer than the sims.

title: Wii运动：度假胜地
creator: Nintendo EAD
note: Wii MotionPlus 让挥剑与掷飞盘有了真实位移，剑术决斗成为 Wii 时代最棒的体感社交。
noteEn: MotionPlus adds real motion to swordplay and disc toss — sword duels are the Wii's best motion-social experience.

title: 实况足球10
creator: Konami
note: 即日版《胜利十一人10》，把拟真传球与战术自由度做到系列巅峰，是 FIFA 全面反超前实况最后的荣光。
noteEn: Known as Winning Eleven 10 — the tactical peak of the series before FIFA caught up for good.
